known_facts: The same record that failed Phase-2 attempt 3 produced four finite beam sequence scores in this isolated run.
All retained non-special token scores were finite in BF16 batched scoring, BF16 per-hypothesis scoring, and FP32-upcast exact-sequence scoring.
The earlier non-finite result is therefore not a stable property of the audio file, generated text, or one fixed scoring path.
The diagnostic did not train a model, compute research metrics, or mutate a Phase-2 cache.
interpretation: The accumulated evidence is consistent with a transient same-protocol low-precision numerical failure. It does not justify filtering, clamping, score replacement, or changing the candidate protocol.

recovery_policy.complete_cache_reuse: Reuse only cache directories with verified immutable manifests.
recovery_policy.partial_cache_reuse: Copy only strict schema-validated finite shards under an explicit source Git commit and write full provenance.
recovery_policy.retry_scope: Only explicitly classified non-finite Whisper generation/scoring failures.
recovery_policy.success_rule: Accept the first strict finite same-protocol result.
